1. Adding proper imports for all icons from '@/components/icons'

4. Adding type="button" to the button element
5. Adding aria-hidden="true" attribute to SVGs for accessibility

There may still be some linter errors due to the complexity of the file structure, but I've addressed the main issues you asked to fix.
